name: ldk-linear-project-ops
description: Role-based Linear work creation, execution, handoff, review, and project reporting for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Perform Linear work as the role responsible for each stage.
interface.longDescription: A human-oriented workflow for creating role-owned work, performing one issue according to its state and resources, handing it to the next role, reviewing Definition of Done evidence, and reporting project queues.
defaultPrompt: Create role-owned Linear issues and resources from this product brief.
Perform issue LDK-123 according to its current role and state.
Report project progress by role, review queue, blockers, and priorities.
